functional.notes: make test passed 79 Vitest tests; make test-e2e passed 29 Playwright tests; agent-browser verified the open workflow shows 0 passing, 0 failing, 3 unreviewed, 0 missing evidence initially, then updates to missing evidence after marking Payment confirmation PASS, then to 1 passing after selecting evidence, and reaches 3 passing with an accepted final verdict after completing all required criteria.

api_contract.notes: Route discovery found app/api/quotes/route.ts, app/api/review-comparison/route.ts, and app/api/review-verdict/route.ts. The status-summary feature is client-derived, but the evidence-review endpoints returned JSON content types, expected 200 bodies for known inputs, and 400 JSON error bodies for unknown scenario or pair inputs.

security.notes: No auth or protected review surface is configured in target-docs, so unauthenticated fixture reads are not treated as bypasses. SQL-style and script-string probes returned 400 JSON errors without stack traces; OPTIONS requests did not emit Access-Control-Allow-Origin for https://evil.com; reviewed responses did not expose passwords, environment values, server paths, or stack traces.

accessibility.notes: not applicable for this feature category

tested_steps: Opened the playground app at http://localhost:3055.
Opened the evidence review workflow with agent-browser.
Verified the initial status summary shows required criteria: 3, passing: 0, failing: 0, unreviewed: 3, missing evidence: 0.
Marked Payment confirmation PASS and verified the summary changes to passing: 0, unreviewed: 2, missing evidence: 1.
Selected Replay: successful payment evidence and verified the summary changes to passing: 1, unreviewed: 2, missing evidence: 0.
Completed the remaining required criteria with passing verdicts and selected evidence, then verified the summary shows passing: 3 and the final verdict is Accepted.
